method: The OCRmyPDF draft and a separate Tesseract hOCR pass were preserved as intermediate evidence. A corrected invisible ReportLab text layer (render mode 3), positioned from actual hOCR line boxes and baselines, was merged onto the clean original page 1 using pypdf. Only the three recorded OCR lines were corrected. The reviewed PDF was not built by layering text onto the erroneous OCRmyPDF draft. Pages 2 and 3 were preserved.
